shortBulletSummary: Crypto markets dip amid macro concerns, with Bitcoin falling to $76,800 and Ethereum near $2,450, extending recent losses.
Higher-than-expected Producer Price Index (PPI) data increased September Fed rate hike probabilities to over 70%.
Brent crude topped $100 due to Iran war, fueling inflation concerns ahead of CPI.
A key Senate procedural vote on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act is set for September 15.
Market sentiment currently stands at 51 (Neutral) on the Crypto Fear & Greed Index, down from previous greed levels.
